races.name: Aarakocra
races.source: MPMM p.6

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

traits.name: Talons
traits.description: You have talons that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Wind Caller
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast the spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it when you cast gust of wind with this trait (choose when you select this race).

races.description: A winged people who originated on the Elemental Plane of Air, aarakocra soar through the sky wherever they wander. From below, aarakocra look like large birds and thus are sometimes called birdfolk.

Flight.notes: Flying speed equal to walking speed; unusable while wearing medium or heavy armor.

Talons.notes: Natural weapon: talons usable for unarmed strikes, dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of bludgeoning.

Wind Caller.notes: At 3rd level, can cast gust of wind without material components once per long rest; can also cast using spell slots of 2nd level or higher. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting race).

races.name: Aasimar
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.7

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage and radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As an action, you can touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. The creature regains a number of hit points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description:
When you reach 3rd level, choose one of the revelation options below. Thereafter, you can use a bonus action to unleash the celestial energy within yourself, gaining the benefits of that revelation. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action. Once you transform using your revelation below, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest:
Necrotic Shroud. Your eyes briefly become pools of darkness, and ghostly, flightless wings sprout from your back temporarily. Creatures other than your allies within 10 feet of you that can see you must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or become frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra necrotic damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.
Radiant Consumption. Searing light temporarily radiates from your eyes and mouth. For the duration, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes radiant damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.
Radiant Soul. Two luminous, spectral wings sprout from your back temporarily. Until the transformation ends, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed, and once on each of your turns, you can deal extra radiant damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

races.description: Aasimar are mortals who carry a spark of the Upper Planes within their souls, resembling their parents but often with subtle celestial features that become more obvious when they reveal their full celestial nature.

Size.notes: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

Healing Hands.notes: As an action, touch a creature to heal it for a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. Usable once per long rest.

Light Bearer.notes: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

Celestial Revelation.notes: At 3rd level, choose one revelation. As a bonus action, transform for 1 minute (once per long rest). Necrotic Shroud: creatures within 10 ft that can see you must succeed on a Charisma save (DC 8 + prof + Cha mod) or be frightened until end of your next turn; once per turn deal extra necrotic damage equal to proficiency bonus. Radiant Consumption: shed bright light 10 ft and dim light 10 ft; at end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 ft takes radiant damage equal to proficiency bonus; once per turn deal extra radiant damage equal to proficiency bonus. Radiant Soul: flying speed equal to walking speed; once per turn deal extra radiant damage equal to proficiency bonus.

races.name: Bugbear
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.8

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Long-Limbed
traits.description: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Sneaky
traits.description: You are proficient in the Stealth skill. In addition, without squeezing, you can move through and stop in a space large enough for a Small creature.

traits.name: Surprise Attack
traits.description: If you hit a creature with an attack roll, the creature takes an extra 2d6 damage if it hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.

races.description: Neither bugs nor bears, bugbears are the hulking cousins of goblins and hobgoblins. They are long of limb and covered in coarse hair, with wedge-shaped ears and pointed teeth.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Long-Limbed.notes: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

Powerful Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Sneaky.notes: Without squeezing, you can move through and stop in a space large enough for a Small creature.

Surprise Attack.notes: If you hit a creature with an attack roll, the creature takes an extra 2d6 damage if it hasn't taken a turn yet in the current combat.

races.name: Centaur
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.9

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 40 feet.

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can immediately follow that attack with a bonus action, making one attack against the target with your hooves.

traits.name: Equine Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. In addition, any climb that requires hands and feet is especially difficult for you because of your equine legs. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

traits.name: Hooves
traits.description: You have hooves that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Natural Affinity
traits.description: Your fey connection to nature gives you an intuitive connection to the natural world and the animals within it. You therefore have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

races.description: Centaurs gallop throughout the multiverse and trace their origins to many different realms. The centaurs presented here hail from the Feywild and mystically resonate with the natural world. From the waist up, they resemble elves, displaying all the elf varieties of skin tone. From the waist down, they have the bodies of horses.

Charge.notes: If you move at least 30 feet straight toward a target and hit it with a melee weapon attack on the same turn, you can use a bonus action to make one additional attack against the target with your hooves.

Equine Build.notes: You count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push or drag. Climbing that requires hands and feet costs 4 extra feet of movement per foot instead of the normal 1 extra foot.

Hooves.notes: Natural weapon: hooves can be used for unarmed strikes, dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage on a hit instead of the normal unarmed strike bludgeoning damage.

Natural Affinity.notes: Proficiency in one skill of your choice from Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

races.name: Changeling
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.10

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Changeling Instincts
traits.description: Thanks to your connection to the fey realm, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.description: As an action, you can change your appearance and your voice. You determine the specifics of the changes, including your coloration, hair length, and sex. You can also adjust your height and weight and can change your size between Medium and Small. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your game statistics change. You can't duplicate the appearance of an individual you've never seen, and you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs that you have. Your clothing and equipment aren't changed by this trait. You stay in the new form until you use an action to revert to your true form or until you die.

races.description: In their true form, changelings appear faded, their features almost devoid of detail. It is rare to see a changeling in that form, for a typical changeling changes their shape the way others might change clothes.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen at character creation).

Changeling Instincts.notes: Choose two skill proficiencies from the listed options.

Shapechanger.notes: As an action, can change appearance and voice, adjust height/weight, and change size between Medium and Small. Game statistics remain unchanged. Cannot duplicate an unseen individual's appearance. Clothing and equipment are not changed. Lasts until an action is used to revert or until death.

races.name: Deep Gnome
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.11

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a gnome for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a gnome.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Gift of the Svirfneblin
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the disguise self spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the nondetection spell with it, without requiring a material component. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Gnomish Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Svirfneblin Camouflage
traits.description: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can make the check with advantage. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

races.description: Deep gnomes, or svirfneblin, are natives of the Underdark and are suffused with that subterranean realm’s magic. They can supernaturally camouflage themselves, and their svirfneblin magic renders them difficult to locate.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid and are also considered a gnome for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a gnome.

Gift of the Svirfneblin.notes: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast disguise self with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast nondetection with it, without requiring a material component. Once you cast either spell with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

Gnomish Magic Resistance.notes: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against spells.

Svirfneblin Camouflage.notes: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check, you can make the check with advantage. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

races.name: Duergar
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.12

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a dwarf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a dwarf.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 120 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Duergar Magic
traits.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the enlarge/reduce spell on yourself with this trait, without requiring a material component. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the invisibility spell on yourself with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself. You also have resistance to poison damage.

traits.name: Psionic Fortitude
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed or stunned condition on yourself.

races.description: Duergar are dwarves whose ancestors were transformed by centuries living in the deepest places of the Underdark, with gray skin and a lifespan of 350 years.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a dwarf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a dwarf.

Duergar Magic.notes: At 3rd level, can cast enlarge/reduce on self once per long rest without material components. At 5th level, can also cast invisibility on self once per long rest without material components. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when selecting race).

Dwarven Resilience.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the poisoned condition on yourself.

Psionic Fortitude.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed or stunned condition on yourself.

races.name: Eladrin
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.13

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Fey Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. When you reach 3rd level, your Fey Step gains an additional effect based on your season; if the effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (choose when you select this race): Autumn. Immediately after you use your Fey Step, up to two creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for 1 minute, or until you or your companions deal any damage to the creatures. Winter. When you use your Fey Step, one creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you before you teleport must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Spring. When you use your Fey Step, you can touch one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature then teleports instead of you, appearing in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet of you. Summer. Immediately after you use your Fey Step, each creature of your choice that you can see within 5 feet of you takes fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can change your season, and you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.description: Eladrin are elves of the Feywild, a realm of perilous beauty and boundless magic. Each eladrin resonates with emotions captured in the Feywild in the form of seasons—affinities that affect the eladrin's mood and appearance.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Fey Step.notes: Bonus action teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Uses equal to proficiency bonus, regained on long rest. At 3rd level, additional seasonal effect: Autumn (charm up to two creatures within 10 ft, Wisdom save), Winter (frighten one creature within 5 ft, Wisdom save), Spring (touch one willing creature within 5 ft to teleport instead of you), Summer (each creature within 5 ft takes fire damage equal to proficiency bonus). Save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (chosen when selecting race).

Trance.notes: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can change your season, and you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.name: Fairy
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.14

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Fairy Magic
traits.description: You know the druidcraft cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the enlarge/reduce spell with this trait. Once you cast faerie fire or enlarge/reduce with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Flight
traits.description: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

races.description: Infused with the magic of the Feywild, most fairies look like Small elves with insectile wings, but each fairy has a special physical characteristic that sets the fairy apart.

Fairy Magic.notes: Knows druidcraft cantrip. At 3rd level can cast faerie fire once per long rest. At 5th level can also cast enlarge/reduce once per long rest. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting race).

Flight.notes: Flying speed equal to walking speed. Cannot use flying speed while wearing medium or heavy armor.

races.name: Firbolg
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.15

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Firbolg Magic
traits.description: You can cast the detect magic and disguise self spells with this trait. When you use this version of disguise self, you can seem up to 3 feet shorter or taller. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Hidden Step
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically turn invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, make a damage roll, or force someone to make a saving throw. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Speech of Beast and Leaf
traits.description: You have the ability to communicate in a limited manner with Beasts, Plants, and vegetation. They can understand the meaning of your words, though you have no special ability to understand them in return. You have advantage on all Charisma checks you make to influence them.

races.description: Distant cousins of giants, firbolgs are tall, forest-dwelling humanoids whose magic entwines with the wild places of the world. They can live up to 500 years.

Firbolg Magic.notes: Can cast detect magic and disguise self (self-only, can appear up to 3 feet shorter or taller) once per long rest each without a spell slot; can also cast them using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

Hidden Step.notes: Bonus action to turn invisible until start of next turn or until attacking, making a damage roll, or forcing a saving throw. Usable a number of times equal to proficiency bonus, regained on long rest.

Powerful Build.notes: Counts as one size larger for determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Speech of Beast and Leaf.notes: Can communicate in a limited manner with Beasts, Plants, and vegetation (they understand you, but you cannot understand them in return). Advantage on all Charisma checks to influence them.

races.name: Air Genasi
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.16

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 35 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Unending Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath indefinitely while you're not incapacitated.

traits.name: Lightning Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to lightning damage.

traits.name: Mingle with the Wind
traits.description: You know the shocking grasp cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the feather fall spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the levitate spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast feather fall or levitate with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

races.description: Air genasi are descended from djinn, the genies of the Elemental Plane of Air. Their skin tones include many shades of blue, along with the full range of human skin tones, with bluish or ashen casts, and their hair might blow in a phantom wind or be made entirely of clouds or vapor.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Unending Breath.notes: Can hold breath indefinitely while not incapacitated.

Mingle with the Wind.notes: Knows shocking grasp cantrip. At 3rd level can cast feather fall once per long rest without material components. At 5th level can also cast levitate once per long rest without material components. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

races.name: Earth Genasi
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.17

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Earth Walk
traits.description: You can move across difficult terrain without expending extra movement if you are using your walking speed on the ground or a floor.

traits.name: Merge with Stone
traits.description: You know the blade ward cantrip. You can cast it as normal, and you can also cast it as a bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 5th level, you can cast the pass without trace spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast that spell with this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast it using any spell slots you have of 2nd level or higher. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

races.description: An earth genasi’s skin can be the colors of stone and earth or a human skin tone with glittering sparkles like gem dust. Some earth genasi have lines marking their skin like cracks, either showing glimmering gemlike veins or a dim, yellowish glow.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Darkvision.notes: In darkness, vision is only in shades of gray.

Earth Walk.notes: Can move across difficult terrain without expending extra movement when using walking speed on the ground or a floor.

Merge with Stone.notes: Knows the blade ward cantrip; can cast it as a bonus action a number of times equal to proficiency bonus (regained on long rest). At 5th level, can cast pass without trace without material components once per long rest (also castable with 2nd-level+ spell slots). Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

races.name: Fire Genasi
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.17

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fire Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

traits.name: Reach to the Blaze
traits.description: You know the produce flame cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the burning hands spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the flame blade spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast burning hands or flame blade with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

races.description: Descended from efreet, the genies of the Elemental Plane of Fire, fire genasi channel the flamboyant and often destructive nature of flame. They show their heritage in their skin tones, which can range from deep charcoal to shades of red and orange.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Reach to the Blaze.notes: Grants innate spellcasting: produce flame cantrip at will; burning hands (1/long rest, no material component) at 3rd level; flame blade (1/long rest, no material component) at 5th level. Spells can also be cast using spell slots of appropriate level. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

races.name: Water Genasi
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.17

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Acid Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to acid damage.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Call to the Wave
traits.description: You know the acid splash cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the create or destroy water spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the water walk spell with this trait, without requiring a material component. Once you cast create or destroy water or water walk with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

races.description: Water genasi descend from marids, aquatic genies from the Elemental Plane of Water. Their skin is often shades of blue or green, sometimes a blend of the two, and their hair can resemble seaweed or water itself.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Speed.notes: Swimming speed equal to walking speed (30 feet).

Call to the Wave.notes: Knows acid splash cantrip. At 3rd level can cast create or destroy water (1/long rest, or with spell slots). At 5th level can also cast water walk (1/long rest, no material component, or with spell slots). Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when selecting the race).

races.name: Githyanki
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.18

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Astral Knowledge
traits.description: You can mystically access a reservoir of experiences of entities connected to the Astral Plane. Whenever you finish a long rest, you gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice, selected from the Player's Handbook, as you momentarily project your consciousness into the Astral Plane. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

traits.name: Githyanki Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the jump spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the misty step spell with it. Once you cast jump or misty step with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

races.description: A lanky people with skin tones of yellows, greens, and browns, githyanki complement their physical prowess with psionic might, instilled in them by mind flayers and cultivated over eons in the Astral Plane.

Astral Knowledge.notes: After each long rest, gain proficiency in one skill of your choice and with one weapon or tool of your choice from the Player's Handbook. These proficiencies last until the end of your next long rest.

Githyanki Psionics.notes: Know mage hand cantrip (hand invisible when cast with this trait). At 3rd level, can cast jump once per long rest. At 5th level, can cast misty step once per long rest. Can also cast jump or misty step using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen at race selection). These spells require no components when cast with this trait.

races.name: Githzerai
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.18-19

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Githzerai Psionics
traits.description: You know the mage hand cantrip, and the hand is invisible when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the shield spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the detect thoughts spell with it. Once you cast shield or detect thoughts with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). None of these spells require spell components when you cast them with this trait.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: Your innate psychic defenses grant you advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed and frightened conditions on yourself.

traits.name: Psychic Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to psychic damage.

races.description: Githzerai are generally slender, with speckled skin in shades of yellow, green, or brown. Eons of cultivating their mental powers within the endless chaos of Limbo have imbued githzerai with the ability to shape psionic energy to protect themselves and probe minds.

Githzerai Psionics.notes: Knows mage hand cantrip (invisible hand when cast via this trait). At 3rd level can cast shield once per long rest. At 5th level can cast detect thoughts once per long rest. Can also cast these spells using spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Int, Wis, or Cha (chosen at race selection). Spells cast via this trait require no spell components.

Mental Discipline.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed and frightened conditions on yourself.

races.name: Goblin
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.20

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description: When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

races.description: Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in caves and other dark places. They are cowardly and cruel, and they delight in the torment of others.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Fury of the Small.notes: When you damage a creature larger than you with an attack or spell, you can deal extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Uses equal to proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest, once per turn.

Nimble Escape.notes: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

races.name: Goliath
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.21

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Mountain Born
traits.description: You have resistance to cold damage. You also naturally acclimate to high altitudes, even if you've never been to one. This includes elevations above 20,000 feet.

traits.name: Stone's Endurance
traits.description: You can supernaturally draw on unyielding stone to shrug off harm. When you take damage, you can use your reaction to roll a d12. Add your Constitution modifier to the number rolled and reduce the damage by that total. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Little Giant
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Athletics skill, and you count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

races.description: Goliaths are distantly related to giants and infused with the supernatural essence of their ancestors’ mountainous home. They stand between 7 and 8 feet tall and have a wide array of skin tones resembling different types of stone.

Mountain Born.notes: Naturally acclimated to high altitudes, including elevations above 20,000 feet.

Stone's Endurance.notes: Reaction when taking damage: roll d12 + Constitution modifier and reduce the damage by that total. Usable a number of times equal to proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest.

Little Giant.notes: Counts as one size larger when determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

races.name: Harengon
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.22

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Hare-Trigger
traits.description: You can add your proficiency bonus to your initiative rolls.

traits.name: Leporine Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Lucky Footwork
traits.description: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're prone or your speed is 0.

traits.name: Rabbit Hop
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

races.description: Harengons are bipedal rabbitfolk with long feet, fur in a variety of colors, keen senses, powerful legs, and a bit of fey luck.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Hare-Trigger.notes: Add proficiency bonus to initiative rolls.

Lucky Footwork.notes: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll a d4 and add it to the save, potentially turning the failure into a success. You can't use this reaction if you're prone or your speed is 0.

Rabbit Hop.notes: As a bonus action, you can jump a number of feet equal to five times your proficiency bonus, without provoking opportunity attacks. You can use this trait only if your speed is greater than 0. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

races.name: Hobgoblin
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.23

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Fey Gift
traits.description: You can use this trait to take the Help action as a bonus action, and you can do so a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, choose one of the options below each time you take the Help action with this trait: Hospitality. You and the creature you help each gain a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d6 plus your proficiency bonus. Passage. You and the creature you help each increase your walking speeds by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Spite. Until the start of your next turn, the first time the creature you help hits a target with an attack roll, that target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes within the next minute.

traits.name: Fortune from the Many
traits.description: If you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or a saving throw, you can draw on your bonds of reciprocity to gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum bonus of +3). You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

races.description: Hobgoblins are Medium Fey (Goblinoid) creatures, typically Lawful Neutral, standing about as tall as humans with a muscular build and a militaristic bearing.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Fey Gift.notes: Take the Help action as a bonus action, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses on a long rest. At 3rd level, choose one of three options each time you use this Help action: Hospitality (you and the helped creature each gain 1d6 + proficiency bonus temporary hit points), Passage (you and the helped creature each increase walking speeds by 10 feet until the start of your next turn), or Spite (until the start of your next turn, the first time the helped creature hits a target with an attack roll, that target has disadvantage on its next attack roll within the next minute).

Fortune from the Many.notes: When you miss with an attack roll or fail an ability check or saving throw, you can add a bonus to the roll equal to the number of allies you can see within 30 feet of you (maximum +3). Usable a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses on a long rest.

races.name: Kenku
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.24

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: Your size is Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Expert Duplication
traits.description: When you copy writing or craftwork produced by yourself or someone else, you have advantage on any ability checks you make to produce an exact duplicate.

traits.name: Kenku Recall
traits.description: Thanks to your supernaturally good memory, you have proficiency in two skills of your choice. Moreover, when you make an ability check using any skill in which you have proficiency, you can give yourself advantage on the check before rolling the d20. You can give yourself advantage in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.description: You can accurately mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations only with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check against a DC of 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

races.description: Feathered folk who resemble ravens, kenku are blessed with keen observation and supernaturally accurate memories. They tend to have the coloration typical of ravens.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Expert Duplication.notes: Advantage on ability checks made to produce an exact duplicate when copying writing or craftwork.

skill_profs: Any two skills of your choice
Kenku Recall.notes: Can give yourself advantage on an ability check using a skill you are proficient in, a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus; regains all expended uses on a long rest.

Mimicry.notes: Can accurately mimic sounds and voices heard; listeners can detect imitation with a Wisdom (Insight) check against DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier.

races.name: Kobold
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.25

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Small.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Draconic Cry
traits.description: As a bonus action, you let out a cry at your enemies within 10 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, you and your allies have advantage on attack rolls against any of those enemies who could hear you. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Kobold Legacy
traits.description: Kobolds’ connection to dragons can manifest in unpredictable ways in an individual kobold. Choose one of the following legacy options for your kobold: Craftiness. You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Sleight of Hand, or Survival. Defiance. You have advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the frightened condition on yourself. Draconic Sorcery. You know one cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for that cantrip (choose when you select this race).

races.description: Kobolds are small, reptilian humanoids with draconic features, often serving dragons and living in underground lairs.

Draconic Cry.notes: Bonus action: enemies within 10 feet that can hear you grant advantage on attack rolls to you and allies until start of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to proficiency bonus, regained on long rest.

Kobold Legacy.notes: Choose one legacy: Craftiness (proficiency in one of Arcana, Investigation, Medicine, Sleight of Hand, or Survival), Defiance (advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the frightened condition on yourself), or Draconic Sorcery (know one sorcerer cantrip, using Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as spellcasting ability).

races.name: Lizardfolk
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.26

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Bite
traits.description: You have a fanged maw that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with it, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 15 minutes at a time.

traits.name: HungryJaws
traits.description: You can throw yourself into a feeding frenzy. As a bonus action, you can make a special attack with your Bite. If the attack hits, it deals its normal damage, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: You have tough, scaly skin. When you aren't wearing armor, your base AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. You can use your natural armor to determine your AC if the armor you wear would leave you with a lower AC. A shield's benefits apply as normal while you use your natural armor.

traits.name: Nature's Intuition
traits.description: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with two of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

races.description: The saurian lizardfolk are thought by some sages to be distant cousins of dragonborn and kobolds. Lizardfolk have colorful scales and exhibit a wide array of scale patterns, and their individual facial features are as varied as those of lizards.

Speed.notes: Swimming speed equal to walking speed (30 ft).

Bite.notes: Natural weapon: fanged maw unarmed strike dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage.

Hold Breath.notes: Can hold breath for up to 15 minutes.

HungryJaws.notes: Bonus action special Bite attack; on hit grants temporary HP equal to proficiency bonus. Usable a number of times equal to proficiency bonus, regained on long rest.

Natural Armor.notes: Base AC = 13 + Dexterity modifier when not wearing armor; can use if worn armor would give lower AC.

Nature's Intuition.notes: Choose two skill proficiencies from the listed options.

races.name: Minotaur
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.27

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Horns
traits.description: You have horns that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier piercing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Goring Rush
traits.description: Immediately after you take the Dash action on your turn and move at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your Horns as a bonus action.

traits.name: Hammering Horns
traits.description: Immediately after you hit a creature with a melee attack as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to push that target with your horns. The target must be within 5 feet of you and no more than one size larger than you. Unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier, you push it up to 10 feet away from you.

traits.name: Labyrinthine Recall
traits.description: You always know which direction is north, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Survival) check you make to navigate or track.

races.description: Minotaurs are barrel-chested humanoids with heads resembling those of bulls. Their horns range in size from about 1 foot long to easily three times that length, and they have heavy, cloven hooves and long, tufted tails.

Horns.notes: Natural weapon: horns used for unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage instead of bludgeoning.

Goring Rush.notes: After taking the Dash action and moving at least 20 feet, you can make one melee attack with your Horns as a bonus action.

Hammering Horns.notes: After hitting with a melee attack, you can use a bonus action to attempt to push the target up to 10 feet away; target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength modifier) or be pushed.

Labyrinthine Recall.notes: You always know which direction is north, and you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to navigate or track.

races.name: Orc
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.28

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Whenever you use this trait, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

races.description: Orcs are a race created by the one-eyed god Gruumsh, possessing toughness and tenacity that allows them to live above or below ground.

Adrenaline Rush.notes: Can take the Dash action as a bonus action a number of times equal to proficiency bonus per long rest. Each use grants temporary hit points equal to proficiency bonus.

Powerful Build.notes: Counts as one size larger for determining carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

Relentless Endurance.notes: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, can drop to 1 hit point instead. Usable once per long rest.

races.name: Satyr
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.29

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 35 feet.

traits.name: Ram
traits.description: You can use your head and horns to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier bludgeoning damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Mirthful Leaps
traits.description: Whenever you make a long jump or a high jump, you can roll a d8 and add the number rolled to the number of feet you cover, even when making a standing jump. This extra distance costs movement as normal.

traits.name: Reveler
traits.description: As an embodiment of revelry, you have proficiency in the Performance and Persuasion skills, and you have proficiency with one musical instrument of your choice.

races.description: Originating in the Feywild—a realm of pure emotion-satyrs thrive on the energy of merriment. They resemble elves but have goatlike legs, cloven hooves, and ram or goat horns.

Ram.notes: Natural weapon: unarmed strike with head/horns deals 1d6 + Strength modifier bludgeoning damage.

Magic Resistance.notes: Advantage on saving throws against spells.

Mirthful Leaps.notes: When making a long or high jump, add 1d8 feet to distance covered, including standing jumps; extra distance costs movement as normal.

tool_profs: One musical instrument of your choice

races.name: Sea Elf
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.30

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Child of the Sea
traits.description: You can breathe air and water, and you have resistance to cold damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Friend of the Sea
traits.description: Aquatic animals have an extraordinary affinity with your people. You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.description: Sea elves are elves who fell in love with the wild beauty of the ocean, navigating currents and exploring the waters of many worlds. They can be found wherever oceans exist, as well as in the Elemental Plane of Water.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid and are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

Speed.notes: You have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

Child of the Sea.notes: You can breathe air and water.

Fey Ancestry.notes: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Friend of the Sea.notes: You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast that has a swimming speed; it can understand your words, but you have no special ability to understand it in return.

Trance.notes: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.name: Shadar-kai
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.31

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Blessing of the Raven Queen
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

traits.name: Necrotic Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic damage.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.description: Shadar-kai are the elves of the Shadowfell, with ashen skin tones and a wizened appearance while in the Shadowfell. They exist in a state between life and death, transformed by the Shadowfell’s grim energy.

Creature Type.notes: You are a Humanoid and are also considered an elf for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be an elf.

Blessing of the Raven Queen.notes: As a bonus action, you can magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Starting at 3rd level, you also gain resistance to all damage when you teleport using this trait. The resistance lasts until the start of your next turn. During that time, you appear ghostly and translucent.

Fey Ancestry.notes: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.

Trance.notes: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a long rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness. Whenever you finish this trance, you can gain two proficiencies that you don't have, each one with a weapon or a tool of your choice selected from the Player's Handbook. You mystically acquire these proficiencies by drawing them from shared elven memory, and you retain them until you finish your next long rest.

races.name: Shifter
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.32

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Bestial Instincts
traits.description: Channeling the beast within, you have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Acrobatics, Athletics, Intimidation, or Survival.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Shifting
traits.description: As a bonus action, you can assume a more bestial appearance. This transformation lasts for 1 minute, until you die, or until you revert to your normal appearance as a bonus action. When you shift, you gain temporary hit points equal to 2 x your proficiency bonus. You can shift a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest. Whenever you shift, you gain an additional benefit based on one of the following options (choose when you select this race): Beasthide. You gain 1d6 additional temporary hit points. While shifted, you have a +1 bonus to your Armor Class. Longtooth. When you shift and as a bonus action on your other turns while shifted, you can use your elongated fangs to make an unarmed strike. If you hit with your fangs, you can deal piercing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. Swiftstride. While shifted, your walking speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, you can move up to 10 feet as a reaction when a creature ends its turn within 5 feet of you. This reactive movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Wildhunt. While shifted, you have advantage on Wisdom checks, and no creature within 30 feet of you can make an attack roll with advantage against you unless you're incapacitated.

races.description: Shifters are descendants of people who contracted full or partial lycanthropy. Humanoids with a bestial aspect, they are similar to humans in height and build but are typically more lithe and flexible, with facial features that have a bestial cast, often with large eyes and pointed ears, and fur-like hair on nearly every part of their bodies.

Bestial Instincts.notes: Choose one skill proficiency from the listed options.

Shifting.notes: Bonus action to shift for 1 minute (or until death or reverting as a bonus action). Gain temporary HP equal to 2 x proficiency bonus. Uses equal to proficiency bonus, regained on long rest. Sub-options: Beasthide: +1d6 additional temporary HP and +1 AC while shifted. Longtooth: while shifted, bonus action unarmed strike with fangs dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier piercing damage. Swiftstride: while shifted, +10 ft walking speed; can move up to 10 ft as a reaction when a creature ends its turn within 5 ft, without provoking opportunity attacks. Wildhunt: while shifted, advantage on Wisdom checks and no creature within 30 ft can attack with advantage against you unless you're incapacitated.

races.name: Tabaxi
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.33

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Cat's Claws
traits.description: You can use your claws to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Cat's Talent
traits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception and Stealth skills.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.description: Your reflexes and agility allow you to move with a burst of speed. When you move on your turn in combat, you can double your speed until the end of the turn. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you move 0 feet on one of your turns.

races.description: Created by the Cat Lord—a divine being of the Upper Planes—to blend the qualities of humanoids and cats, tabaxi are a varied people in both attitude and appearance. Their appearance is as varied as their attitudes, with features or patterning in their fur like tigers, jaguars, or other big cats, while others have appearances more like a house cat.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Speed.notes: Climbing speed equal to walking speed (30 feet).

Cat's Claws.notes: Natural weapon: claws usable for unarmed strikes, dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of bludgeoning.

Feline Agility.notes: Can double speed until end of turn when moving in combat; recharges after moving 0 feet on a turn.

races.name: Tortle
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.34

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: You have claws that you can use to make unarmed strikes. When you hit with them, the strike deals 1d6 + your Strength modifier slashing damage, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.description: You can hold your breath for up to 1 hour.

traits.name: Natural Armor
traits.description: Your shell provides you a base AC of 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can't wear light, medium, or heavy armor, but if you are using a shield, you can apply the shield's bonus as normal.

traits.name: Nature's Intuition
traits.description: Thanks to your mystical connection to nature, you gain proficiency with one of the following skills of your choice: Animal Handling, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, or Survival.

traits.name: Shell Defense
traits.description: You can withdraw into your shell as an action. Until you emerge, you gain a +4 bonus to your AC, and you have advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in your shell, you are prone, your speed is 0 and can't increase, you have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, you can't take reactions, and the only action you can take is a bonus action to emerge from your shell.

races.description: Tortles are turtle folk who live on many worlds, most often journeying up and down coasts, along waterways, and across the sea. They exhibit the same range of coloration and patterns found among turtles, and many tortles enjoy adorning their shells in distinctive ways.

Size.notes: Size is Medium or Small (chosen when selecting the race).

Claws.notes: Natural weapon: claws usable for unarmed strikes, dealing 1d6 + Strength modifier slashing damage instead of the normal bludgeoning damage.

Hold Breath.notes: Can hold breath for up to 1 hour.

Natural Armor.notes: Dexterity modifier does not affect AC. Cannot wear light, medium, or heavy armor; shield bonus applies normally.

Nature's Intuition.notes: Gain proficiency with one skill of your choice from the listed options.

Shell Defense.notes: As an action, withdraw into shell: +4 bonus to AC, advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws; while withdrawn you are prone, speed is 0 and can't increase, disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, can't take reactions, and only action is a bonus action to emerge.

races.name: Triton
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.35

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet, and you have a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Control Air and Water
traits.description: You can cast fog cloud with this trait. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the gust of wind spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the water walk spell with it. Once you cast any of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Emissary of the Sea
traits.description: You can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity that has a swimming speed. It can understand your words, though you have no special ability to understand it in return.

traits.name: Guardian of the Depths
traits.description: Adapted to the frigid ocean depths, you have resistance to cold damage.

races.description: Tritons have webbed hands and feet, small fins on their calves, and coloration that favors blues and greens.

Speed.notes: Swimming speed equal to walking speed (30 ft).

Control Air and Water.notes: Innate spellcasting: fog cloud (1st level); gust of wind (3rd level); water walk (5th level). Each castable once per long rest without a spell slot, or with spell slots. Spellcasting ability is Int, Wis, or Cha (chosen at race selection).

Emissary of the Sea.notes: Can communicate simple ideas to any Beast, Elemental, or Monstrosity with a swimming speed; they can understand you but you cannot understand them.

races.name: Yuan-ti
races.source: Mordenkainen Presents: Monsters of the Multiverse p.36

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid.

traits.name: Size
traits.description: You are Medium or Small. You choose the size when you select this race.

traits.name: Speed
traits.description: Your walking speed is 30 feet.

traits.name: Darkvision
