features.description: The sibriex emits an aura of corruption 30 feet in every direction. Vegetation withers in the aura, and the ground in the aura is difficult terrain for other creatures. Any creature that starts its turn in the aura must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw or take 14 (4d6) poison damage. A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to this sibriex's Contamination for 24 hours.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the sibriex fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The sibriex has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sibriex makes three Chain attacks, and it uses Squirt Bile.

actions.name: Chain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d12 + 7) force damage.

actions.name: Squirt Bile
actions.description: The sibriex targets one creature it can see within 120 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take 31 (9d6) acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The sibriex casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):
At will: command, dispel magic, hold monster
yday.feeblemind

actions.name: Warp Creature
actions.description: The sibriex targets up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it. Each target must make a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, a creature becomes immune to this sibriex's Warp Creature. On a failed save, the target is poisoned, which causes it to also gain 1 level of exhaustion. While poisoned in this way, the target must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. Three successful saves against the poison end it, and ending the poison removes any levels of exhaustion caused by it. Each failed save causes the target to gain another level of exhaustion. Once the target reaches 6 levels of exhaustion, it dies and instantly transforms into a living manes (see the Monster Manual) under the sibriex's control. The transformation of the body can be undone only by a wish spell.

legendary_actions.name: Cast a Spell
legendary_actions.description: The sibriex uses Spellcasting.

legendary_actions.name: Spray Bile
legendary_actions.description: The sibriex uses Squirt Bile.

legendary_actions.name: Warp (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The sibriex uses Warp Creature.

features.name: Fallible Invisibility
features.description:
The skulk is invisible. This invisibility can be circumvented by three things:
Charnel Candles. The skulk appears as a dim, translucent form in the light of a candle made of fat rendered from a corpse whose identity is unknown.
Children. Humanoid children, aged 10 and under, can see through this invisibility.
Reflective Surfaces. The skulk appears as a drab, smooth-skinned biped if its reflection can be seen in a mirror or on another surface.

features.name: Trackless
features.description: The skulk leaves no tracks to indicate where it has been or where it's headed.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Skull Lord
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: all the languages it knew in life

features.name: Evasion
features.description: If the skull lord is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half the damage, the skull lord instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails, provided it isn't incapacitated.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the skull lord fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Master of the Crave
features.description: While within 30 feet of the skull lord, any Undead ally of the skull lord makes saving throws with advantage, and that ally regains 1d6 hit points whenever it starts its turn there.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The skull lord doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The skull lord casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18):
At will: mage hand, message
2/day each: dimension door, fear
1/day each: cloudkill, cone of cold

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The skull lord makes three Bone Staff or Deathly Ray attacks.

actions.name: Bone Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Deathly Ray
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +10 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (5d8 + 5) necrotic damage.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord makes one Bone Staff or Deathly Ray attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Summon Undead (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The skull lord summons up to five skeletons or zombies (both appear in the Monster Manual) in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it. They remain until destroyed. Undead summoned in this way roll initiative, act in the next available turn, and obey the skull lord. The skull lord can have no more than five Undead summoned by this ability at a time.

monsters.name: Slithering Tracker
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: understands languages it knew in its previous form but can't speak

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: If the slithering tracker is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the slithering tracker move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the slithering tracker isn't a puddle.

features.name: Liquid Form
features.description: The slithering tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can also move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The slithering tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Life Leech
actions.description:
One Large or smaller creature that the slithering tracker can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. In addition, the grappled target takes 16 (3d10) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The slithering tracker can grapple only one target at a time.
While grappling the target, the slithering tracker takes only half any damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the target takes the other half.

monsters.name: Angry Sorrowsworn
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Two Heads
features.description: The sorrowsworn has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

features.name: Rising Anger
features.description: If another creature deals damage to the sorrowsworn, the sorrowsworn's attack rolls have advantage until the end of its next turn, and the first time it hits with a Hook attack on its next turn, the attack's target takes an extra 19 (3d12) psychic damage. On its turn, the sorrowsworn has disadvantage on attack rolls if no other creature has dealt damage to it since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sorrowsworn makes two Hook attacks.

actions.name: Hook
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d12 + 3) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Hungry Sorrowsworn
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Life Hunger
features.description: If a creature within 60 feet of the sorrowsworn regains hit points, the sorrowsworn gains two benefits until the end of its next turn: it has advantage on attack rolls, and its Bite deals an extra 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a hit.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sorrowsworn makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 16), and it is restrained until the grapple ends. While grappling a creature, the sorrowsworn can't make a Claw attack.

monsters.name: Lonely Sorrowsworn
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Psychic Leech
features.description: At the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

features.name: Thrives on Company
features.description: The sorrowsworn has advantage on attack rolls while it is within 30 feet of at least two other creatures. It otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sorrowsworn makes one Harpoon Arm attack, and it uses Sorrowful Embrace.

actions.name: Harpoon Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (4d8 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 15) if it is a Large or smaller creature. The sorrowsworn has two harpoon arms and can grapple up to two creatures at once.

actions.name: Sorrowful Embrace
actions.description: Each creature grappled by the sorrowsworn must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 18 (4d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. In either case, the sorrowsworn pulls each of those creatures up to 30 feet straight toward it.

monsters.name: Lost Sorrowsworn
damage_resistances: slashing while in dim light or darkness

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The sorrowsworn makes two Arm Spike attacks.

actions.name: Arm Spike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2dl0 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Embrace (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4dl0 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. Until the grapple ends, the target is frightened, and it takes 27 (6d8) psychic damage at the end of each of its turns. The sorrowsworn can grapple only one creature at a time.

reactions.name: Tightening Embrace
reactions.description: If the sorrowsworn takes damage, the creature grappled by Embrace takes 18 (4d8) psychic damage.

monsters.name: Wretched Sorrowsworn
damage_resistances: slashing while in dim light or darkness

features.name: Wretched Pack Tactics
features.description: The sorrowsworn has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the sorrowsworn's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated. The sorrowsworn otherwise has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (IdlO + 1) piercing damage, and the sorrowsworn attaches to the target. While attached, the sorrowsworn can't attack, and at the start of each of the sorrowsworn's turns, the target takes 6 (IdlO + 1) necrotic damage. The attached sorrowsworn moves with the target whenever the target moves, requiring none of the sorrowsworn's movement. The sorrowsworn can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement on its turn. A creature, including the target, can use its action to detach the sorrowsworn.

monsters.name: Spawn of Kyuss
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The spawn of Kyuss regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or a body of running water. If the spawn takes acid, fire, or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the spawn's next turn. The spawn is destroyed only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Worms
features.description: If the spawn of Kyuss is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, all the worms infesting it wither away, and it loses its Burrowing Worm action.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The spawn of Kyuss requires no air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The spawn of Kyuss makes two Claw attacks, and it uses Burrowing Worm.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1 d6 + 3) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Burrowing Worm
actions.description: A worm launches from the spawn of Kyuss at one Humanoid that the spawn can see within 10 feet of it. The worm latches onto the target's skin unless the target succeeds on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. The worm is a Tiny Undead with AC 6, 1 hit point, a 2 (-4) in every ability score, and a speed of 1 foot. While on the target's skin, the worm can be killed by normal means or scraped off using an action (the spawn can use Burrowing Worm to launch a scraped-off worm at a Humanoid it can see within 10 feet of the worm). Otherwise, the worm burrows under the target's skin at the end of the target's next turn, dealing 1 piercing damage to it. At the end of each of its turns thereafter, the target takes 7 (2d6) necrotic damage per worm infesting it (maximum of 1 Od6), and if it drops to 0 hit points, it dies and then rises 10 minutes later as a spawn of Kyuss. If a worm-infested target is targeted by an effect that cures disease or removes a curse, all the worms infesting it wither away.

features.name: Aura of Shrieks
features.description: Creatures within 20 feet of the grue that aren't Aberrations have disadvantage on saving throws, as well as on attack rolls against creatures other than a star spawn grue.

actions.name: Confounding Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw or attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of the grue's next turn.

monsters.name: Star Spawn Hulk
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Psychic Mirror
features.description: If the hulk takes psychic damage, each creature within 10 feet of the hulk takes that damage instead; the hulk takes none of the damage. In addition, the hulk's thoughts and location can't be discerned by magic.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The hulk makes two Slam attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target also takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the target's next turn.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Reaping Arms (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The hulk makes a separate Slam attack against each creature within 10 feet of it. Each creature that is hit must also succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

monsters.name: Star Spawn Larva Mage
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Return to Worms
features.description: When the mage is reduced to 0 hit points, it breaks apart into a swarm of insects (see the Monster Manual) in the same space. Unless the swarm is destroyed, the mage reforms from it 24 hours later.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The mage casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: mage hand, message, minor illusion
1/day: dominate monster

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mage makes three Slam or Eldritch Bolt attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Eldritch Bolt
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Plague of Worms (Recharge 6)
actions.description: Each creature other than a star spawn within 10 feet of the mage must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or take 22 (5d8) necrotic damage and be blinded and restrained by masses of swarming worms. The affected creature takes 22 (5d8) necrotic damage at the start of each of the mage's turns. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

reactions.name: Feed on Weakness
reactions.description: When a creature within 20 feet of the mage fails a saving throw, the mage gains 10 temporary hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Slam
legendary_actions.description: The mage makes one Slam attack.

legendary_actions.name: Eldritch Bolt (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The mage makes one Eldritch Bolt attack.

legendary_actions.name: Feed (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Each creature restrained by the mage's Plague of Worms takes 13 (3d8) necrotic damage, and the mage gains 6 temporary hit points.

features.name: Ambusher
features.description: The mangler has advantage on initiative rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The mangler makes two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage. If the attack roll has advantage, the target also takes 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Flurry of Claws (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The mangler makes six Claw attacks. Either before or after these attacks, it can move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Stealth
bonus_actions.description: While in dim light or darkness, the mangler takes the Hide action.

monsters.name: Star Spawn Seer
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Out-of-Phase Movement
features.description: The seer can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, and its movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. Each creature it moves through takes 5 (1d10) psychic damage; no creature can take this damage more than once per turn. The seer takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The seer makes two Comet Staff or Psychic Orb attacks.

actions.name: Comet Staff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) psychic damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be incapacitated until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Psychic Orb
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +11 to hit, range 120 feet, one creature. Hit: 27 (5d10) psychic damage.

actions.name: Collapse Distance (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The seer warps space around one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. That creature must make a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, is teleported up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the seer can see, and then each creature within 10 feet of the target's original space takes 39 (6d12) psychic damage. On a successful save, the target takes 19 (3d12) psychic damage and isn't teleported.

reactions.name: Bend Space
reactions.description: When the seer would be hit by an attack roll, it teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, exchanging positions with another star spawn it can see within 60 feet of it. The other star spawn is hit by the attack instead.

features.name: Extraordinary Leap
features.description: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to move 3 feet.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

features.name: Extraordinary Leap
features.description: The distance of the steeder's long jumps is tripled; every foot of its walking speed that it spends on the jump allows it to jump 3 feet.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The steeder can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Sticky Leg
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Small or Tiny creature. Hit: The target is stuck to the steeder's leg and grappled (escape DC 12). The steeder can have only one creature grappled at a time.

monsters.name: Steel Predator
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 17
languages: understands Modron and the language of its owner but can't speak

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The steel predator has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The steel predator doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The steel predator makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The steel predator casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:
3/day each: dimension door (self only), plane shift (self only)

actions.name: Stunning Roar (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The steel predator emits a roar in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 19 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 33 (6d10) thunder damage, drops everything it's holding, and is stunned for 1 minute. The stunned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

monsters.name: Stone Cursed
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Cunning Opportunist
features.description: The stone cursed has advantage on the attack rolls of opportunity attacks.

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: If the stone cursed is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the stone cursed move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the stone cursed isn't a statue.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The stone cursed doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Petrifying Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw, or it begins to turn to stone and is restrained until the end of its next turn, when it must repeat the saving throw. The effect ends if the second save is successful; otherwise the target is petrified for 24 hours.

features.name: Dreamwalker's Charm
features.description: An enemy that starts its turn within 30 feet of the giant must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw, provided that the giant isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature is charmed by the giant. A creature charmed in this way can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once it succeeds on the saving throw, the creature is immune to this giant's Dreamwalker's Charm for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Greatclub or Rock attacks.

actions.name: Greatclub
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (4d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Petrifying Touch
actions.description: The giant touches one Medium or smaller creature within 10 feet of it that is charmed by it. The target must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes petrified, and the giant can adhere the target to its stony body. Greater restoration spells and other magic that can undo petrification have no effect on a petrified creature adhered to the giant unless the giant is dead, in which case the magic works normally, freeing the petrified creature as well as ending the petrified condition on it.

monsters.name: Storm Giant Quintessent
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The giant can breathe air and water.

features.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
features.description: If the giant fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The giant makes two Lightning Sword attacks, or it uses Wind Javelin twice.

actions.name: Lightning Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 40 (9d6 + 9) lightning damage.

actions.name: Wind Javelin
actions.description: The giant coalesces wind into a javelin-like form and hurls it at a creature it can see within 600 feet of it. The javelin deals 19 (3d6 + 9) force damage to the target, striking unerringly. The javelin disappears after it hits.

legendary_actions.name: Gust
legendary_actions.description: The giant targets a creature it can see within 60 feet of it and creates a magical gust of wind around the target, who must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be moved up to 20 feet in any horizontal direction the giant chooses.

legendary_actions.name: Thunderbolt (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The giant hurls a thunderbolt at a creature it can see within 600 feet of it. The target must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: One with the Storm (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The giant vanishes, dispersing itself into the storm surrounding its lair. The giant can end this effect at the start of any of its turns, becoming a giant once more and appearing in any location it chooses within its lair. While dispersed, the giant can't take any actions other than lair actions, and it can't be targeted by attacks, spells, or other effects. The giant can't use this ability outside its lair, nor can it use this ability if another creature is using a control weather spell or similar magic to quell the storm.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny maggot. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: Bites
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +0 to hit, reach 0 ft., one creature in the swarm's space. Hit: 7 (2d6) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. At the end of each of the poisoned target's turns, the target takes 3 (1d6) poison damage. Whenever the poisoned target takes fire damage, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. If the poisoned target ends its turn with 0 hit points, it dies.

features.name: Suave Defense
features.description: While the swashbuckler is wearing light or no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Charisma modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The swashbuckler makes one Dagger attack and two Rapier attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

monsters.name: Sword Wraith Commander
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Turning Defiance
features.description: The commander and any other sword wraiths within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn Undead.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The commander doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The commander makes two Longsword or Longbow attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Call to Honor (1/Day)
actions.description: If the commander has taken damage during this combat, it gives itself advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn, and 1d4 + 1 sword wraith warriors appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it. The warriors last until they drop to 0 hit points, and they take their turns immediately after the commander's turn on the same initiative count.

bonus_actions.name: Martial Fury
bonus_actions.description: The commander makes one Longsword or Longbow attack, which deals an extra 9 (2d8) necrotic damage on a hit, and attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

monsters.name: Sword Wraith Warrior
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
languages: the languages it knew in life

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The warrior doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Battleaxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Martial Fury
bonus_actions.description: The warrior makes one Battleaxe or Longbow attack, and attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The tanarukk has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tanarukk makes one Bite attack and one Greatsword attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

reactions.name: Unbridled Fury
reactions.description: In response to being hit by a melee attack, the tanarukk can make one Bite or Greatsword attack with advantage against the attacker.

bonus_actions.name: Aggressive
bonus_actions.description: The tanarukk moves up to its speed toward an enemy that it can see.

monsters.name: Titivilus
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Titivilus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Titivilus has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: Titivilus regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If he takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn. Titivilus dies only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Ventriloquism
features.description: Whenever Titivilus speaks, he can choose a point within 60 feet of him; his voice emanates from that point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Titivilus makes one Silver Sword attack, and he uses Frightful Word.

actions.name: Silver Sword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) force damage, or 9 (1d10 + 4) force damage if used with two hands, plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the necrotic damage taken.

actions.name: Frightful Word
actions.description: Titivilus targets one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of him for 1 minute. While frightened in this way, the target must take the Dash action and move away from Titivilus by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move, in which case it needn't take the Dash action. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
Titivilus casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21):
At will: alter self, major image, nondetection, sending, suggestion
3/day each: mislead, modify memory

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: Titivilus teleports, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

actions.name: Twisting Words
actions.description: Titivilus targets one creature he can see within 60 feet of him. The target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw or become charmed by Titivilus for 1 minute. The charmed target can repeat the saving throw if Titivilus deals any damage to it. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to Titivilus's Twisting Words for 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Corrupting Guidance
legendary_actions.description: Titivilus uses Twisting Words. Alternatively, he targets one creature charmed by him that is within 60 feet of him; that charmed target must succeed on a DC 21 Charisma saving throw, or Titivilus decides how the target acts during its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Titivilus uses Teleport.

legendary_actions.name: Assault (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Titivilus makes one Silver Sword attack, or he uses Frightful Word.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tlincalli makes one Longsword or Spiked Chain attack and one Sting attack.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing damage, or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Spiked Chain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tlincalli can't use the spiked chain against another target.

actions.name: Sting
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. If it fails the saving throw by 5 or more, the target is also paralyzed while poisoned. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands in melee.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

features.name: Hold Breath
features.description: The tortle can hold its breath for 1 hour.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The tortle casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
At will: druidcraft, guidance
2/day each: cure wounds, hold person, speak with animals, thunderwave

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The tortle makes four Claw attacks or two Nature's Wrath attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Nature's Wrath
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, range 90 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) damage of a type chosen by the tortle: cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.

actions.name: Shell Defense
actions.description: The tortle withdraws into its shell. Until it emerges, it gains a +4 bonus to AC and has advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws. While in its shell, the tortle is prone, its speed is 0 and can't increase, it has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws, it can't take reactions, and the only action it can take is a bonus action to emerge.

monsters.name: Trapper
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 11

features.name: False Appearance
features.description: If the trapper is motionless on a floor, wall, or ceiling at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the trapper move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 18 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the trapper isn't part of the floor, wall, or ceiling.

features.name: Spider Climb
features.description: The trapper can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Smother
actions.description: One Large or smaller creature within 10 feet of the trapper must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or be grappled (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target takes 13 (3d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 3 (1d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. While grappled in this way, the target is restrained, blinded, and deprived of air. The trapper can smother only one creature at a time.

monsters.name: Dire Troll
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, it regains only 5 hit points at the start of its next turn. The troll dies only if it is hit by an attack that deals 10 or more acid or fire damage while the troll has 0 hit points.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes one Bite attack and four Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 6) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) poison damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Whirlwind of Claws (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature within 10 feet of the troll must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 44 (8d10) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

features.name: Rancid Degeneration
features.description: At the end of each of the troll's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) necrotic damage, unless the troll has taken acid or fire damage since the end of its last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 16 (3d10) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) necrotic damage.

monsters.name: Spirit Troll
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Incorporeal Movement
features.description: The troll can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes psychic or force damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The stunned target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage.

features.name: Poison Splash
features.description: When the troll takes damage of any type but psychic, each creature within 5 feet of the troll takes 9 (2d8) poison damage.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The troll regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the troll takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the troll's next turn. The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The troll makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage, and the target is poisoned until the start of the troll's next turn.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) poison damage.

actions.name: Venom Spray (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The troll slices itself with a claw, releasing a spray of poison in a 15-foot cube. The troll takes 7 (2d6) slashing damage, which can't be reduced in any way. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't poisoned. A poisoned creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Creature Sense
features.description: The ulitharid is aware of the presence of creatures within 2 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each creature's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a mind blank spell, a nondetection spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The ulitharid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Psionic Hub
features.description: If an elder brain establishes a psychic link with the ulitharid, the elder brain can form a psychic link with any other creature the ulitharid can detect using its Creature Sense. Any such link ends if the creature falls outside the telepathy ranges of both the ulitharid and the elder brain. The ulitharid can maintain its psychic link with the elder brain regardless of the distance between them, so long as they are both on the same plane of existence. If the ulitharid is more than 5 miles away from the elder brain, it can end the psychic link at any time (no action required).

features.name: Spellcasting (Psionics)
features.description:
The ulitharid casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At will: detect thoughts, levitate
1/day each: dominate monster, feeblemind, mass suggestion, plane shift (self only), project image, scrying, telekinesis

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is grappled (escape DC 14) and must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or be stunned until this grapple ends.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one incapacitated Humanoid grappled by the ulitharid. Hit: 55 (10d10) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ulitharid kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

actions.name: Mind Blast (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The ulitharid magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 17 Intelligence saving throw or take 31 (4d12 + 5) psychic damage and be stunned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monsters.name: Vampiric Mist
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Life Sense
features.description: The mist can sense the location of any creature within 60 feet of it, unless that creature's type is Construct or Undead.

features.name: Forbiddance
features.description: The mist can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

features.name: Misty Form
features.description: The mist can occupy another creature's space and vice versa. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can pass through it without squeezing. Each foot of movement in water costs it 2 extra feet, rather than 1 extra foot. The mist can't manipulate objects in any way that requires fingers or manual dexterity.

features.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
features.description: The mist takes 10 radiant damage whenever it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, the mist has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

features.name: Unusual Nature
features.description: The mist doesn't require air or sleep.

actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: The mist touches one creature in its space. The target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw (Undead and Constructs automatically succeed), or it takes 10 (2d6 + 3) necrotic damage, the mist regains 10 hit points, and the target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

monsters.name: Vargouille
languages: understands Abyssal, Infernal, and any languages it knew before becoming a vargouille but can't speak

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Abyssal Curse
actions.description: The vargouille targets one incapacitated Humanoid within 5 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Charisma saving throw or become cursed. The cursed target loses 1 point of Charisma after each hour, as its head takes on fiendish aspects. The curse doesn't advance while the target is in sunlight or the area of a daylight spell; don't count that time. When the cursed target's Charisma becomes 2, it dies, and its head tears from its body and becomes a new vargouille. Casting remove curse, greater restoration, or a similar spell on the target before the transformation is complete can end the curse. Doing so undoes the changes made to the target by the curse.

actions.name: Stunning Shriek (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The vargouille shrieks. Each Humanoid and Beast within 30 feet of the vargouille and able to hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the vargouille until the end of the vargouille's next turn. While frightened in this way, a target is stunned. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to the Stunning Shriek of all vargouilles for 1 hour.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The vegepygmy regains 3 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The vegepygmy has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The vegepygmy regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vegepygmy's next turn. The vegepygmy dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The vegepygmy makes two Claw attacks or two melee Spear attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spear
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

actions.name: Spores (1/Day)
actions.description: A 15-foot-radius cloud of toxic spores extends out from the vegepygmy. The spores spread around corners. Each creature in that area that isn't a Plant must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned. While poisoned in this way, a target takes 9 (2d8) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The thorny has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The thorny regains 5 hit points at the start of its turn. If it takes cold, fire, or necrotic damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the thorny's next turn. The thorny dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Thorny Body
features.description: At the start of its turn, the thorny deals 2 (1d4) piercing damage to any creature grappling it.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The war priest casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: light, spare the dying, thaumaturgy 1/day each: banishment, command, dispel magic, flame strike, guardian of faith, hold person, lesser restoration, revivify

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The war priest makes two Maul attacks, and it uses Holy Fire.

actions.name: Maul
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) radiant damage.

actions.name: Holy Fire
actions.description: The war priest targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 12 (2d8 + 3) radiant damage, and it is blinded until the start of the war priest's next turn. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At will: dancing lights, disguise self, mage armor (self only), mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, speak with animals 1/day each: charm person, dimension door, hold monster

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warlock makes two Rapier attacks, or it uses Bewildering Word twice.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Bewildering Word
actions.description: The warlock utters a magical bewilderment, targeting one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or take 9 (2d8) psychic damage and have disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of the warlock's next turn.

reactions.name: Misty Escape
reactions.description: In response to taking damage, the warlock turns invisible and teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. It remains invisible until the start of its next turn or until it attacks, makes a damage roll, or casts a spell.

monsters.name: Warlock of the Fiend
languages: any two languages (usually Abyssal or Infernal)

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: When the warlock makes an ability check or saving throw, it can add a d10 to the roll. It can do this after the roll is made but before any of the roll's effects occur.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: alter self, mage armor (self only), mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation 1/day each: banishment, plane shift, suggestion

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warlock makes three Scimitar attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Hellfire
actions.description: Green flame explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet of the warlock. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) fire damage and 11 (2d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Fiendish Rebuke
reactions.description: In response to being damaged by a visible creature within 60 feet of it, the warlock forces that creature to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

monsters.name: Warlock of the Great Old One

features.name: Whispering Aura
features.description: At the start of each of the warlock’s turns, each creature of its choice within 10 feet of it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or take 10 (3d6) psychic damage, provided the warlock isn’t incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warlock makes two Dagger attacks.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Howling Void
actions.description: The warlock opens a momentary extraplanar rift within 60 feet of it. The rift is a scream-filled, 20-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 9 (2d8) psychic damage and is frightened of the warlock until the start of the warlock's next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn’t frightened.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The warlock casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: detect magic, guidance, levitate, mage armor (self only), mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, speak with dead
1/day each: arcane gate, detect thoughts, true seeing

features.name: Indomitable (3/Day)
features.description: The warlord can reroll a saving throw it fails. It must use the new roll.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: The warlord regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has fewer than half its hit points but at least 1 hit point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The warlord makes two Greatsword or Shortbow attacks.

actions.name: Greatsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) slashing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage.

legendary_actions.name: Command Ally
legendary_actions.description: The warlord targets one ally it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear the warlord, the target can make one weapon attack as a reaction and gains advantage on the attack roll.

legendary_actions.name: Weapon Attack
legendary_actions.description: The warlord makes one Greatsword or Shortbow attack.

legendary_actions.name: Frighten Foe (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The warlord targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see or hear it, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the warlord until the end of warlord’s next turn.

monsters.name: Wastrilith
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: The wastrilith can breathe air and water.

features.name: Corrupt Water
features.description:
At the start of each of the wastrilith's turns, exposed water within 30 feet of it is befouled. Underwater, this effect lightly obscures the area until a current clears it away. Water in containers remains corrupted until it evaporates.
A creature that consumes this foul water or swims in it must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is immune to the foul water for 24 hours. On a failed save, the creature takes 14 (4d6) poison damage and is poisoned for 1 minute. At the end of this time, the poisoned creature must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes 18 (4d8) poison damage and is poisoned until it finishes a long rest.
If another demon drinks the foul water as an action, it gains 11 (2d10) temporary hit points.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The wastrilith has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wastrilith makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks, and it uses Grasping Spout.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 30 (4d12 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Grasping Spout
actions.description: The wastrilith magically launches a spout of water at one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target must make a DC 17 Strength saving throw, and it has disadvantage if it's underwater. On a failed save, it takes 22 (4d8 + 4) acid damage and is pulled up to 60 feet toward the wastrilith. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't pulled.

bonus_actions.name: Undertow
bonus_actions.description: If the wastrilith is underwater, it causes all water within 60 feet of it to be difficult terrain for other creatures until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) force damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The apprentice casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12):
At will: mage hand, prestidigitation
1/day each: burning hands, disguise self, mage armor

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The abjurer casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At will: dancing lights, mage hand, message, prestidigitation 2/day each: dispel magic, lightning bolt, mage armor 1/day each: arcane lock, banishment, globe of invulnerability, invisibility, wall of force

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The abjurer makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) force damage.

actions.name: Force Blast
actions.description: Each creature in a 20-foot cube originating from the abjurer must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 36 (8d8) force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from the abjurer. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

reactions.name: Arcane Ward (Recharge 4-6)
reactions.description: When the abjurer or a creature it can see within 30 feet of it takes damage, the abjurer magically creates a protective barrier around itself or the other creature. The barrier reduces the damage to the protected creature by 26 (4d10 + 4), to a minimum of 0, and then vanishes.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The conjurer casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At will: dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation 2/day each: fireball, mage armor, unseen servant 1/day each: fly, stinking cloud, web

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The conjurer makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) radiant damage.

On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't stunned.

reactions.name: Portent (3/Day)
reactions.description: When the diviner or a creature it can see makes an attack roll, a saving throw, or an ability check, the diviner rolls a d20 and chooses whether to use that roll in place of the d20 rolled for the attack roll, saving throw, or ability check.

features.name: Spellcasting

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The enchanter makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) psychic damage.

reactions.name: Instinctive Charm (Recharge 4-6)
reactions.description: When a visible creature within 30 feet of the enchanter makes an attack roll against it, the enchanter forces the attacker to make a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attacker redirects the attack roll to the creature closest to it, other than the enchanter or itself. If multiple eligible creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: The evoker casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At will: light, mage hand, message, prestidigitation 2/day each: ice storm, lightning bolt, mage armor 1/day: wall of ice
