actions.description: The evoker unleashes a magical explosion of a particular damage type: cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The magic erupts in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 150 feet of the evoker. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. The evoker can select up to three creatures it can see in the area to ignore the spell, as the evoker sculpts the spell's energy around them. On a failed save, a creature takes 40 (9d8) damage of the chosen type and is knocked prone. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The illusionist casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: dancing lights, mage hand, minor illusion
2/day each: disguise self, invisibility, mage armor, major image, phantasmal force, phantom steed

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The illusionist makes two Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d10 + 3) psychic damage.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The necromancer casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15):
At will: dancing lights, mage hand, prestidigitation
2/day each: bestow curse, dimension door, mage armor, web
1/day: circle of death

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The necromancer makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (4d10 + 3) necrotic damage.

reactions.name: Crim Harvest
reactions.description: When the necromancer kills a creature with necrotic damage, the necromancer regains 9 (2d8) hit points.

features.name: Transmuter's Stone
features.description:
The transmuter carries a magic stone it crafted. The stone grants it one of the following benefits while bearing the stone; the transmuter chooses the benefit at the end of each long rest:
Darkvision. The transmuter has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
Resilience. The transmuter has proficiency in Constitution saving throws.
Resistance. The transmuter has resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (transmuter's choice whenever choosing this benefit).
Speed. The transmuter's walking speed is increased by 10 feet.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The transmuter casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At will: light, message, prestidigitation
2/day each: fireball, hold person, knock, mage armor, polymorph, slow
1/day: telekinesis

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The transmuter makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Burst
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) acid damage.

features.name: Plant Camouflage
features.description: The wood woad has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks it makes in any terrain with ample obscuring vegetation.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: The wood woad regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it is in contact with the ground. If the wood woad takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the wood woad's next turn. The wood woad dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

features.name: Tree Stride
features.description: Once on each of its turns, the wood woad can use 10 feet of its movement to step magically into one living tree within 5 feet of it and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of it that it can see, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The wood woad makes two Club attacks.

actions.name: Club
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d4 + 4) force damage.

features.name: Raxivort's Tongue
features.description: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage. If at least one of the xvart's allies is within 5 feet of the target, the xvart can push the target 5 feet if the target is a Medium or smaller creature.

actions.name: Sling
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

features.name: Raxivort's Blessing
features.description: When the xvart reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, the xvart gains 4 temporary hit points.

features.name: Raxivort's Tongue
features.description: The xvart can communicate with ordinary bats and rats, as well as giant bats and giant rats.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The xvart makes two Scimitar or Raxivort's Bite attacks.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Raxivort's Bite
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, range 30 ft., one creature. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) poison damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The xvart casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11):
At will: detect magic, mage armor (self only), mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation
1/day each: burning hands, invisibility

monsters.name: Yagnoloth
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 16

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yagnoloth has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description:
The yagnoloth casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
At will: darkness, detect magic, dispel magic, invisibility (self only), suggestion
3/day: lightning bolt

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yagnoloth makes one Electrified Touch attack and one Massive Arm attack, or it makes one Massive Arm attack and uses Battlefield Cunning, if available, or Teleport.

actions.name: Electrified Touch
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (6d8) lightning damage.

actions.name: Massive Arm
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 23 (3d12 + 4) force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or become stunned until the end of the yagnoloth's next turn.

actions.name: Battlefield Cunning (Recharge 4-6)
actions.description: Up to two allied yugoloths within 60 feet of the yagnoloth that can hear it can use their reactions to make one melee attack each.

actions.name: Life Leech
actions.description: The yagnoloth touches one incapacitated creature within 15 feet of it. The target takes 36 (7d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the yagnoloth gains temporary hit points equal to half the damage dealt. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw, or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to half the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest, and the target dies if its hit point maximum is reduced to 0.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The yagnoloth teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

monsters.name: Yeenoghu
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing that is nonmagical

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If Yeenoghu fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Yeenoghu has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Yeenoghu makes three Flail attacks.

actions.name: Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) force damage. If it's his turn, Yeenoghu can cause the target to suffer one of the following additional effects, each of which he can apply only once per turn: Confusion. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or be affected by the confusion spell until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn. Force. The target takes an extra 13 (2d12) force damage. Paralysis. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed until the start of Yeenoghu's next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (2d10 + 9) acid damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description: Yeenoghu casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At will: detect magic 3/day each: dispel magic, fear, invisibility 1/day: teleport

legendary_actions.name: Charge
legendary_actions.description: Yeenoghu moves up to his speed.

legendary_actions.name: Swat Away
legendary_actions.description: Yeenoghu makes one Flail attack. If the attack hits, the target must succeed on a DC 24 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet in a straight line away from Yeenoghu. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the target is also knocked prone.

legendary_actions.name: Savage (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Yeenoghu makes a separate Bite attack against each creature within 10 feet of him.

monsters.name: Yeth Hound
damage_immunities: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks not made with silvered weapons
languages: understands Common, Elvish, and Sylvan but can't speak

features.name: Sunlight Banishment
features.description: If the yeth hound starts its turn in sunlight, it is transported to the Ethereal Plane. While sunlight shines on the spot from which it vanished, the hound must remain in the Deep Ethereal. After sunset, it returns to the Border Ethereal at the same spot, whereupon it typically sets out to find its pack or its master. The hound is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane. Once it is adjacent to its master or a pack mate that is on the Material Plane, a yeth hound in the Border Ethereal can return to the Material Plane as an action.

features.name: Telepathic Bond
features.description: While the yeth hound is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage, plus 14 (4d6) psychic damage if the target is frightened.

actions.name: Baleful Baying
actions.description: The yeth hound bays magically. Every enemy within 300 feet of the hound that can hear it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the hound until the end of the hound's next turn or until the hound is incapacitated. A frightened target that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hound must use all its movement on that turn to get as far from the hound as possible, must finish the move before taking an action, and must take the most direct route, even if hazards lie that way. A target that successfully saves is immune to the baying of all yeth hounds for the next 24 hours.

monsters.name: Yuan-ti Anathema
monsters.senses: blindsight 30 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 21

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The anathema has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Ophidiophobia Aura
features.description: Any creature of the anathema's choice, other than a snake or a yuan-ti, that starts its turn within 30 feet of the anathema must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of snakes and yuan-ti. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this anathama's aura for the next 24 hours.

features.name: Six Heads
features.description: The anathema has advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack (Anathema Form Only)
actions.description: The anathema makes two Claw attacks and one Flurry of Bites attack.

actions.name: Claw (Anathema Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d6 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Flurry of Bites (Anathema Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 27 (6d6 + 6) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Constrict (Snake Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 15 ft., one Large or smaller creature. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 16). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and it takes 16 (3d6 + 6) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The anathema can constrict only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Anathema Form Only)
actions.description:
The anathema casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17):
At will: animal friendship (snakes only)
3/day each: darkness, entangle, fear, polymorph, suggestion

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The anathema transforms into a Huge constrictor snake or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

features.name: Reckless
features.description: At the start of its turn, the broodguard can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The broodguard makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the yuan-ti's darkvision.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Sseth's Blessing
features.description: When the yuan-ti reduces an enemy to 0 hit points, the yuan-ti gains 9 temporary hit points.

features.name: Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only)
features.description:
The yuan-ti casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: animal friendship (snakes only), message, minor illusion, prestidigitation
3/day: suggestion
2/day each: detect thoughts, hypnotic pattern

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yuan-ti makes two Bite attacks and one Scimitar attack, or it makes two Spectral Fangs attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spectral Fangs
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) psychic damage.

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the yuan-ti's darkvision.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yuan-ti makes one Constrict attack and one Scimitar attack, or it makes two Spectral Fangs attacks.

actions.name: Constrict
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 14) if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. The yuan-ti can constrict only one creature at a time.

actions.name: Scimitar (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Spectral Fangs
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Invoke Nightmare (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.description: The yuan-ti taps into the nightmares of one creature it can see within 60 feet of it and creates an illusory, immobile manifestation of the creature's deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 22 (4d10) psychic damage and is frightened of the manifestation, believing it to be real. The yuan-ti must concentrate to maintain the illusion (as if concentrating on a spell), which lasts for up to 1 minute and can't be harmed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the illusion on a success or taking 11 (2d10) psychic damage on a failure.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.description:
The yuan-ti casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):
At will: animal friendship (snakes only), mage hand, message, prestidigitation
3/day: suggestion
2/day each: darkness, fear

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The yuan-ti transforms into a Medium snake or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. If it dies, it stays in its current form.

features.name: Devil's Sight
features.description: Magical darkness doesn't impede the yuan-ti's darkvision.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: The yuan-ti has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yuan-ti makes three Bite attacks or two Spectral Fangs attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Spectral Fangs
actions.description: Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) poison damage.

actions.name: Merrshaulk's Slumber (1/Day)
actions.description: The yuan-ti targets up to five creatures that it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or fall into a magical sleep and be unconscious for 10 minutes. A sleeping target awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake. This magical sleep has no effect on a creature immune to being charmed.

actions.name: Spellcasting (Yuan-ti Form Only)
actions.description:
The yuan-ti casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):
At will: animal friendship (snakes only), guidance, mage hand, message
3/day: suggestion
2/day each: hold person, invisibility

bonus_actions.name: Change Shape
bonus_actions.description: The yuan-ti transforms into a Medium snake or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It doesn't change form if it dies.

monsters.name: Zaratan
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monsters.senses: darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 15

features.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
features.description: If the zaratan fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.description: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures (included in Earth-Shaking Movement).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zaratan makes one Bite attack and one Stomp attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 28 (4d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Stomp
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3dl0 + 10) thunder damage.

actions.name: Spit Rock
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, range 120 ft./240 ft., one target. Hit: 31 (6d8 + 10) force damage.

actions.name: Spew Debris (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: The zaratan exhales rocky debris in a 90-foot cube. Each creature in that area must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 33 (6dl0) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is knocked prone.

actions.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
actions.description: After moving at least 10 feet on the ground, the zaratan sends a shock wave through the ground in a 120-foot-radius circle centered on itself. That area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature on the ground that is concentrating must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw or the creature's concentration is broken. The shock wave deals 100 thunder damage to all structures in contact with the ground in the area. If a creature is near a structure that collapses, the creature might be buried; a creature within half the distance of the structure's height must make a DC 25 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 17 (5d6) bludgeoning damage, is knocked prone, and is trapped in the rubble. A trapped creature is restrained, requiring a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check as an action to escape. Another creature within 5 feet of the buried creature can use its action to clear rubble and grant advantage on the check. If three creatures use their actions in this way, the check is an automatic success. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone or become trapped.

legendary_actions.name: Stomp
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan makes one Stomp attack.

legendary_actions.name: Move
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan moves up to its speed.

legendary_actions.name: Spit (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan makes one Spit Rock attack.

legendary_actions.name: Retract (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan retracts into its shell. Until it takes its Emerge action, it has resistance to all damage, and it is restrained. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Revitalize or Emerge action.

legendary_actions.name: Revitalize (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell. It regains 52 (5d20) hit points. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Emerge action.

legendary_actions.name: Emerge (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The zaratan emerges from its shell and makes one Spit Rock attack. It can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell.

damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.description: Zariel has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Regeneration
features.description: Zariel regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn. If she takes radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of her next turn. Zariel dies only if she starts her turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Zariel makes three melee attacks: one with her Flail and two with her Longsword.

actions.name: Flail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) slashing damage, or 19 (2d10 + 8) slashing damage if used with two hands, plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +16 to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) piercing damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.

actions.name: Immolating Gaze (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Zariel turns her magical gaze toward one creature she can see within 120 feet of her and commands it to burn. The target must succeed on a DC 26 Wisdom saving throw or take 22 (4d10) fire damage and have the blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Teleport
legendary_actions.description: Zariel magically teleports, along with any equipment she is wearing and carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space she can see.

legendary_actions.name: Immolating Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: Zariel uses Immolating Gaze.

legendary_actions.name: Infernal Command
legendary_actions.description: Zariel chooses up to three allies she can see within 60 feet of her. Each target can use its reaction to make one melee weapon attack.

actions.name: Pseudopod

actions.name: Spellcasting

Zuggtmoy casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 22):
At will: detect magic, locate animals or plants
3/day each: dispel magic, entangle, plant growth
1/day each: etherealness, teleport

reactions.name: Protective Thrall
reactions.description: When Zuggtmoy is hit by an attack roll, one creature within 10 feet of her that is charmed by her is hit by the attack instead.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.description: Zuggtmoy makes one Pseudopod attack.

legendary_actions.name: Exert Will
